description: Get recent activity across all your courses: new announcements, discussion replies, graded submissions and messages, newest first. Read-only. Titles and messages are fenced as untrusted text. For counts only, use get_activity_stream_summary; for one course, use get_course_activity_stream.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Smaller is faster.

only_active_courses.description: Only include activity from currently active courses. Default true.

name: get_activity_stream
title: Get Activity Stream
